description:
When registering your team, your team of 4 will have to create a 'team name' (ie. Team Rockstars, Wildcats, Hogliners, Game of Stones, Ring Leaders, Curl Power, Lord of the Ice, etc.) Please give the name and information for all 4 players. 

PAYMENT MUST BE RECEIVED PRIOR TO THE COMPETITION TO BE ELIGIBLE TO PLAY.  
 
OPTION 1: Pay now via credit card. CURLSASK will provide a full refund to all registered teams less $5/player administration fee should the event be cancelled.
 
OPTION 2: Mail a cheque to CURLSASK, 613 Park St, Regina, SK S4N 5N1. Cheques will not be deposited until after the registration deadline. Should the event be cancelled, cheques will be destroyed. Select the CASH/CHEQUE option upon registering.
 
OPTION 3:  Pay via etransfer using the email curling@curlsask.ca, using the comment box to indicate which team the payment should be applied to.  Select the CASH/CHEQUE option upon registering. CURLSASK will provide a full refund to all registered teams less $5/player administration fee should the event be cancelled.
